result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: a truncated restaurant name in the Fastest near you carousel and a partially cut-off category chip.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word under the third card in Fastest near you, so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or ensure horizontal cards allocate enough width/ellipsis with full name on detail view.

issues.description: The category filter row shows a partial empty/white chip on the far right edge beyond 'Healthy', which looks like a broken or incomplete control.
issues.suggestion: Clip the scroll view cleanly at the screen edge without showing an empty chip fragment, or ensure only fully styled chips are rendered in the scrollable list.
